sentences.show: This king never appeared in public on a Tuesday. Then he had to.
King Alexander of Yugoslavia had lost three relatives on Tuesdays, and avoided them.
But his visit to France began on a Tuesday, in Marseille.
He rode slowly through the streets with France's foreign minister, Louis Barthou.
A newsreel camera was rolling, just metres away.
A gunman leapt onto the car and shot the king and his driver.
He was Vlado Chernozemski, a Bulgarian revolutionary of the IMRO, allied with the Ustaše.
The king died in the car, one of the first assassinations caught on film.
Barthou was hit in the arm, and bled to death.
A ballistic report, hidden until 1974, revealed the truth.
The bullet that killed him came from a French police gun.
Also on this day: Leeuwenhoek first described microscopic life, and the Washington Monument opened.
